dedupe_keys.name: vehicle trajectory dataset from drone collected data at three swiss roundabouts

description: Vehicle Trajectory Dataset from Drone-Collected Data at Three Swiss Roundabouts is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jasso Espadaler-Clapés, Robert Fonod (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne). Overview This dataset provides high-resolution, georeferenced vehicle trajectories collected via drone footage at three roundabouts located in the municipalities of Frick and Laufenburg, Canton of Aargau, Switzerland. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
